    • readFromInput

      protected <T> T readFromInput(String prompt, Predicate<T> checker, AbstractCLI.Mapper<String,T> mapper, boolean acceptCommands)
      Reads the client's inputs.
      Type Parameters:
      T - generic used to return different types of converted inputs.
      Parameters:
      prompt - the message printed to ask the client to input something.
      checker - predicate that checks if the client's input is valid.
      mapper - mapper that converts the client's input into the correct requested type.
      acceptCommands - whether commands should be accepted or not
      Returns:
      the converted client's input.
      See Also:
